nota: Curated external facts for report/build_offshore_wind.py: figures read on the web that docs/data/*.json does not hold in structured form. Each item has source, link, date of the figure, date read and reliability. The build script warns when an item is older than its max_age_days. Edit here, never in the script.

rvo_roadmap.fonte: RVO, New offshore wind farms (Offshore Wind Energy Roadmap table), page checked by RVO on 19 August 2026; Letter to Parliament on the Gamma-B tender, 16 March 2026
rvo_roadmap.nota: Roadmap table: Alpha Q3 2029, Beta Q4 2029, Gamma-A and Gamma-B Q2 2032; Nederwiek I-A, I-B, II, III, Doordewind I-II, Ten noorden van de Waddeneilanden, Hollandse Kust (west) VIII 'to be determined'. The page cites a 23 GW roadmap goal without a year (21 GW plus over-programming of Doordewind II). The March 2026 letter still describes the roadmap as 'approximately 21 GW of offshore wind energy around 2030' and expects the Gamma farms in 2032, with permits in Q1 2027. The end-2032 date for 21 GW comes from the 2024 planning update (offshoreWIND.biz, 29 April 2024; wind-calendar WC-NL-TARGET).

turbine_trimestre.fonte: Siemens Energy, Earnings Release Q3 FY 2026 (5 August 2026); GE Vernova, Q3 2026 press release, SEC Form 8-K (28 October 2026)
turbine_trimestre.sgre_nota: Siemens Energy: Siemens Gamesa 'reported a positive result for the first time since fiscal year 2022' (April-June 2026); the EUR 75 m profit before special items is from secondary summaries (GuruFocus, Business News Today); FY2026 guidance: break-even margin before special items.
turbine_trimestre.gev_nota: Wind segment EBITDA USD 72 m in Q3 2026 (USD -61 m a year earlier), mainly from lower Offshore Wind project costs and tariff recoveries; 2026 guidance changed to USD 400-500 m of segment EBITDA losses (from about 400 m).

cadeler_h1.nota: Ten operating vessels; the slight fall is attributed to lower Q1 2026 utilisation as new vessels joined; 'Cadeler's order book for 2026 is substantially filled'. Backlog including options at 25 August 2026; 77% relates to projects with a positive FID. The Q1 figure (47.6%) is in eolico-filiera.json from the Q1 report, not in the H1 report.

windeurope_filiera.investimenti_testo: Since 2022 manufacturers and suppliers have announced at least EUR 15bn in investments ... from turbines and components to ports and offshore vessels. Nearly half of these investments target manufacturing, with 70% focused on offshore.
windeurope_filiera.nota: eolico-filiera.json gives EUR 15.4 bn, a figure not in the PDF (15.4 appears only in Figure 17, as 2017 onshore investment), and a 2025 base of 442,800 jobs: in Figure 27 442,800 is 2024 (2025: 484,700). The report uses the PDF.
